app.name: ClimbSpot
app.tagline: Find the hills worth climbing near you.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or has moved.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request could not be understood.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some information is missing or invalid.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.ASCENT_NOT_FOUND: This climb does not exist or has been removed.
errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE: Your account could not be deleted right now, and nothing was erased. Please try again later.
errors.SAVED_ITINERARY_NOT_FOUND: This itinerary is no longer saved.
errors.SAVED_ITINERARY_TOO_LARGE: This itinerary is too large to be saved.
errors.GPX_INVALID: This file is not a valid GPX file.
errors.GPX_EMPTY: This file has no track or route with at least two points.
errors.GPX_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large. Use a file under 5 MB with at most 20,000 points.
errors.ASCENT_TOO_LONG: This path is too long. A climb is at most 50 km.
errors.ASCENT_TOO_FLAT: This path is too flat. A climb averages at least 3 %.
errors.ASCENT_TOO_LOW: This path does not gain enough height. A climb gains at least 10 m.
errors.ASCENT_DIP_TOO_LARGE: This path goes down too much along the way. Split it into two climbs.
errors.ELEVATION_UNAVAILABLE: Elevation data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach ClimbSpot. Check your connection.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
errors.ROUTING_UNAVAILABLE: Planning is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

input.metric: Your pace on the flat (min:s per km)
input.imperial: Your pace on the flat (min:s per mile)

errors.format: Enter a pace as minutes and seconds, like 5:30.
errors.range: Enter a pace between {{fastest}} and {{slowest}} per {{unit}}.

pace.invite: Set your pace to see the time
